content: {"summary":"Customers report frequent unexpected shutdowns and hardware failures, such as faulty SSDs and GPU issues, causing long repair cycles and frustration [#tk_2583097, #tk_553627]. Software updates like High Sierra trigger boot failures and kernel panics, leaving machines unusable and requiring manual recovery steps [#tk_2558730, #tk_2913320, #tk_2305982]. Users also experience persistent noise, sticky keys, and static interruptions that degrade usability and productivity [#tk_2305180, #tk_563071]. Repeated reboots after installing Boot Camp or OS upgrades further highlight stability gaps in older models [#tk_596843, #tk_2917330]."}
